separation.en: The separation of teaching and research functions weakens institutional coherence.
separation.zh: 教学与研究职能的分离削弱了机构内部的一致性。

separation.en: Laboratory separation of samples prevented cross-contamination during the survey.
separation.zh: 实验室对样本的分离避免了调查过程中的交叉污染。

separation.en: Judicial separation of powers provides a check on regulatory discretion.
separation.zh: 司法权力的分离为监管裁量提供了制衡。

severity.en: The severity of the decline in literacy was underestimated by policymakers.
severity.zh: 决策者低估了识字率下降的严重程度。

severity.en: Clinical severity scores were recorded for each participant at enrollment.
severity.zh: 研究在入组时记录了每位参与者的临床严重程度评分。

severity.en: Regulators graded the severity of the violation and imposed corresponding penalties.
severity.zh: 监管机构对违规行为的严重程度作出分级，并施加相应处罚。

simulation.en: Simulation results suggest that the proposed design would reduce structural failure.
simulation.zh: 模拟结果表明，拟议的设计方案能够降低结构失效的风险。

simulation.en: The simulation of rainfall patterns helped planners test drainage capacity.
simulation.zh: 对降水模式的模拟帮助规划人员检验排水能力。

simulation.en: Students used simulation to explore how policy choices affect market outcomes.
simulation.zh: 学生借助模拟来探索政策选择如何影响市场结果。

specification.en: The technical specification requires that all sensors meet stringent accuracy thresholds.
specification.zh: 该技术规范要求所有传感器满足严格的精度阈值。

specification.en: Ambiguous wording in the specification led to disputes during contract review.
specification.zh: 规范中的表述含糊，导致合同审查期间出现争议。

specification.en: Regulators revised the specification to reflect recent advances in material science.
specification.zh: 监管机构修订了规范，以反映材料科学领域的近期进展。

stability.en: Long-term stability of the composite was tested under repeated thermal cycling.
stability.zh: 复合材料在反复热循环条件下的长期稳定性接受了检验。

stability.en: The findings suggest considerable stability in the relationship across cohorts.
stability.zh: 研究结果表明，该关系在不同队列中具有相当高的稳定性。

stability.en: Political stability in the region determined the pace of institutional reform.
stability.zh: 该地区的政治稳定性决定了制度改革的推进节奏。

sufficiency.en: The sufficiency of the evidence was challenged by members of the review panel.
sufficiency.zh: 评审委员会成员对证据的充分性提出了质疑。

sufficiency.en: Sufficiency of statistical power depends on the expected size of the treatment effect.
sufficiency.zh: 统计检验效能的充分性取决于预期处理效应的大小。

sufficiency.en: The report questions the sufficiency of current funding for long-term archival work.
sufficiency.zh: 该报告质疑现行资金对长期档案工作的支持是否充分。

supervision.en: Effective supervision requires clear reporting lines between field staff and headquarters.
supervision.zh: 有效的监督要求田野人员与总部之间建立清晰的工作汇报关系。

supervision.en: The agency strengthened supervision of licensed laboratories after a series of violations.
supervision.zh: 在一系列违规行为发生之后，该机构加强了对持证实验室的监督。

supervision.en: Supervision of early-career researchers reduced uncertainty during the transition period.
supervision.zh: 对职业早期研究人员的指导降低了过渡阶段的不确定性。

supplement.en: A supplement to the main report contains the detailed methodological appendix.
supplement.zh: 主报告的补充材料包含详细的方法学附录。

supplement.en: Dietary supplement use was recorded among participants during the follow-up interview.
supplement.zh: 研究在随访访谈中记录了参与者的膳食补充剂使用情况。

supplement.en: The supplement provides additional context for the interpretation of the historical data.
supplement.zh: 该补充材料为历史数据的解读提供了额外背景。

survival.en: Survival rates for the transplanted seedlings declined sharply during the drought.
survival.zh: 移栽幼苗的存活率在干旱期间急剧下降。

survival.en: The model estimates survival probability under alternative assumptions about mortality.
survival.zh: 该模型在关于死亡率的不同假设下估算存活概率。

survival.en: Corporate survival in competitive markets depends on continuous organizational adaptation.
survival.zh: 企业在竞争性市场中的存续取决于持续的组织调适。

tactic.en: The committee adopted a negotiation tactic intended to reduce the financial burden.
tactic.zh: 委员会采取了一种旨在减轻财政负担的谈判策略。

tactic.en: Each research group selected a different recruitment tactic for the target population.
tactic.zh: 各研究小组针对目标人群选择了不同的招募策略。

tactic.en: Prolonged delay was recognized as a common tactic in regulatory evasion.
tactic.zh: 拖延被认定为规避监管的一种常见手段。

technology.en: Advances in technology have reduced the cost of large-scale data collection.
technology.zh: 技术进步降低了大规模数据采集的成本。

technology.en: The technology transfer office mediates cooperation between the university and industry.
technology.zh: 技术转移办公室在高校与产业之间的合作中发挥协调作用。

technology.en: Adoption of the technology was uneven across regions with comparable infrastructure.
technology.zh: 该技术在基础设施相当的不同地区之间呈现出不均衡的采纳状况。

tendency.en: The tendency of respondents to overstate income persists across repeated survey waves.
tendency.zh: 受访者夸大收入的倾向在多次调查波次中持续存在。

tendency.en: There is a marked tendency for graduate attrition to increase with departmental size.
tendency.zh: 研究生流失率随院系规模增大而上升的倾向十分明显。

tendency.en: His tendency to generalize from single cases weakened the analytical rigor of the review.
tendency.zh: 他倾向于从个别案例进行概括，这一特点削弱了评审的严谨性。

terminology.en: Differences in terminology complicate the comparison of results across regional studies.
terminology.zh: 术语上的差异使各地区研究结果之间的比较变得复杂。

terminology.en: The authors propose a standardized terminology for describing qualitative coding decisions.
terminology.zh: 作者提出了标准化的术语体系，用于描述定性编码的决策过程。

terminology.en: Ambiguity in the terminology of the directive led to divergent administrative interpretations.
terminology.zh: 指令术语上的歧义导致了截然不同的行政解释。

tolerance.en: Tolerance of measurement error varies substantially across instruments and laboratories.
tolerance.zh: 不同仪器和实验室对测量误差的容忍程度存在显著差异。

tolerance.en: The policy depends on public tolerance of a modest increase in taxation.
tolerance.zh: 该政策取决于公众对适度税收增长的容忍程度。

tolerance.en: Genetic differences in drug tolerance explain part of the variation in treatment response.
tolerance.zh: 药物耐受性的遗传差异解释了治疗反应变异的部分来源。
